events.text: Juliana turns abruptly toward the first row of pews, where her elderly father sits gripping an ornate brass cane.
Close-up on the father's hand tightly gripping the gold curved handle of his walking cane.

events.speaker: LADY JULIANA
events.text: "Father..."

events.speaker: LADY JULIANA
events.text: "Tell them this is a mistake."
Wide shot showing Juliana dropping to her knees beside her seated father, pleading with him.
Close-up on the father's weathered face, looking fixedly at the floor, refusing to meet her gaze.

events.speaker: LADY JULIANA
events.text: "Father... please look at me."
Close-up on Juliana looking up at him, tears streaming uncontrollably down her cheeks.
The father tightens his jaw and stony expression, refusing to offer a single word or look.
Profile close-up of the father staring blankly forward.
Low-angle shot looking up at the Matriarch commanding the space with regal severity.

events.speaker: MATRIARCH
events.text: "Enough!"

events.speaker: MATRIARCH
events.text: "You have embarrassed this family long enough."

events.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
events.text: "Miss Ashcroft."
Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man pause on the stone steps, turning slightly back toward Lord Ashcroft.
Close-up of Lord Ashcroft, his weathered face rigid with aristocratic pride and disgust.

events.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
events.text: "You will not leave this church carrying the Ashcroft name."
Medium close-up of Juliana looking up at her father. Her hand rises to touch the amethyst heirloom pendant resting at her throat.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "The vows are spoken, Father. I am his wife now."
Medium shot of Lord Ashcroft standing rigid outside the chapel archway, unforgiving and unyielding.

events.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
events.text: "Then leave as his wife."

events.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
events.text: "You leave as no daughter of mine."
Low-angle shot tracking Lord Ashcroft's polished black boots as he slowly descends the stone steps toward them.

events.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
events.text: "Your dowry is revoked."

events.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
events.text: "Your inheritance is revoked."
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes wide with shock and heartbreak as she holds the ledger close against her chest.

events.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
events.text: "From this moment, you are dead to the Ashcroft family."

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "You truly mean it? You are my father!"
Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man, observing Lord Ashcroft with an unblinking, quietly threatening stare.

events.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
events.text: "And you have chosen to become a stranger."
Profile medium two-shot of Juliana and Lord Ashcroft standing face-to-face against the backdrop of the towering gothic facade.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "No, Father. You chose that long before today."
Medium close-up of Lady Ashcroft, resplendent in navy velvet and jewels, stepping forward with a smirk of malicious authority.

events.speaker: LADY ASHCROFT
events.text: "Enough sentiment."

events.speaker: LADY ASHCROFT
events.text: "And the ledger..."
Medium shot as Lady Ashcroft approaches Juliana menacingly.

events.speaker: LADY ASHCROFT
events.text: "...that belongs to this family."

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "It belonged to my mother! It is all I have left of her."
Close-up of Lady Ashcroft laying a jeweled hand firmly on the bound book.

events.speaker: LADY ASHCROFT
events.text: "Then you should have guarded it better."

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "Barbara, don't!"

events.speaker: JULIANA

events.text: Heavy carriage wheels grinding in mud, horse snorts, and rhythmic hoofbeats halting.
Medium shot as Aristocratic Woman steps out of the carriage into the misty air, shielding herself under an intricate lace parasol in an elegant lavender gown.
Gerald steps down from the carriage behind her, looking immaculate in a high-collared navy frock coat, white waistcoat, and dark cravat.
Aristocratic Woman smirks cruelly as she surveys the humble stone cottage.
Juliana rinses the heavy mud from her hands in a cold rainwater puddle and rises to her feet, holding her head high.

events.speaker: ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN
events.text: "This is where you live now?"
Medium shot of Gerald standing beside Aristocratic Woman, sneering disdainfully.

events.speaker: GERALD
events.text: "A fitting home for a woman who threw away everything for a penniless soldier."

events.text: Juliana stops grinding and lifts her head sharply toward the entrance in alarm.
Close-up of Alexander turning toward the doorway, his eyes sharp and vigilant.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "Stay back. I'll open it."
Alexander steps forward and unlatches the cottage door, opening it into the pouring rain.
Medium shot framing the doorway as a soaked, distraught peasant mother steps across the threshold clutching a swaddled child.

events.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
events.text: "Please! They told me there was a woman here who knows herbs. My boy is burning with fever!"
Medium shot of Juliana rushing to the front of the table, extending her arms urgently.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "Bring him here. Quickly."
The trembling mother gently lays the feverish boy down atop the wooden table as Juliana leans in close.
Close-up of Juliana gently placing her fingers against the boy's burning forehead.
Medium close-up of Juliana examining the boy's breathing, looking up toward the frantic mother.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "He seems very unwell, but he is resting steadily. How long has he been like this?"
Medium two-shot of Alexander watching anxiously over the child's shoulder as Juliana tends to him.
Medium close-up of the peasant mother clutching her shawl, tears running down her cheeks.

events.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
events.text: "Since yesterday morning. He has barely eaten since sunset."
Close-up of Juliana resting two fingers against the boy's wrist, measuring his shallow pulse.
Juliana lifts the weathered herbal book and rapidly browses the handwritten pages.
Insert close-up of the open page illustrated with botanical drawings labeled 'Feverfew'.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "Feverfew... Not alone."
Profile close-up of Juliana studying the grimoire's remedies intently while the mother weeps in the soft background.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "Chamomile... and willow bark."
Close-up of Alexander leaning over the table, gazing at her with intense concern.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "You're certain?"
Close-up of Juliana looking up into his eyes with resolute conviction.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "I have to be."
Juliana quickly grabs bundles of dried herbs from the table and turns to Alexander.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "Alexander, I need hot water."

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "I'm on it."
Alexander hurries to the hearth and lifts a boiling iron kettle from the hearth chain, while the mother buries her face in her hands.

events.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
events.text: "Please save him."

boundary_events.text: Heavy, frantic pounding echoes against the heavy wooden cottage door.
Alexander returns and pours steaming hot water into the stone mortar as Juliana prepares the remedy.

[00:28.80-00:31.00] [CAMERA] Insert close-up of the open page illustrated with botanical drawings labeled 'Feverfew'.
[00:29.00-00:30.80] JULIANA (Muttering, Intent): "Feverfew... Not alone."
[00:31.00-00:34.00] [CAMERA] Profile close-up of Juliana studying the grimoire's remedies intently while the mother weeps in the soft background.
[00:31.80-00:33.80] JULIANA (Determined): "Chamomile... and willow bark."
[00:34.00-00:36.00] [CAMERA] Close-up of Alexander leaning over the table, gazing at her with intense concern.
[00:34.90-00:35.80] ALEXANDER (Grave): "You're certain?"
[00:36.00-00:38.00] [CAMERA] Close-up of Juliana looking up into his eyes with resolute conviction.
[00:36.30-00:37.40] JULIANA (Resolute): "I have to be."
[00:38.00-00:39.80] [ACTION] Juliana quickly grabs bundles of dried herbs from the table and turns to Alexander.
[00:38.20-00:39.80] JULIANA (Urgent): "Alexander, I need hot water."
[00:39.90-00:40.80] ALEXANDER (Prompt): "I'm on it."
[00:40.80-00:42.50] [ACTION] Alexander hurries to the hearth and lifts a boiling iron kettle from the hearth chain, while the mother buries her face in her hands.
[00:41.00-00:42.50] PEASANT MOTHER (Sobbing): "Please save him."
[00:42.20-00:43.50] [ACTION] Alexander returns and pours steaming hot water into the stone mortar as Juliana prepares the remedy.
[00:43.00-00:46.00] [CAMERA] Medium close-up of Juliana clasping the mother's trembling hand across the wooden table.
[00:43.80-00:45.60] JULIANA (Gentle, Steadfast): "He is not beyond saving."
[00:46.00-00:48.00] [CAMERA] Close-up of Juliana carefully administering the herbal brew with a small wooden spoon into the sick boy's mouth.
[00:47.00-00:48.20] [ACTION] The child swallows weakly and lets out a soft cough.
[00:48.00-00:50.50] [CAMERA] Close-up of the mother clutching her chest in anxious suspense.
[00:50.50-00:52.50] [CAMERA] Medium close-up of Juliana sitting quietly beside the boy, holding two fingers over his wrist to monitor his pulse.
[00:52.50-00:54.00] [CAMERA] Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the mother leaning across the table in panic.
[00:52.50-00:54.00] PEASANT MOTHER (Despairing): "Why isn't it working?"
[00:54.00-00:56.00] [CAMERA] Close-up of Juliana raising a calm finger, urging patience.
[00:54.30-00:55.20] JULIANA (Quiet, Focused): "Wait."
[00:56.00-00:58.50] [CAMERA] Close-up of the sleeping boy as beads of sweat form on his forehead, his breathing deepening.
[00:58.50-01:02.00] [CAMERA] Close-up of the mother gently caressing her son's cheek, sobbing with relief.
[00:58.80-01:01.80] PEASANT MOTHER (Overcome with Emotion): "His fever... it's breaking."
[01:02.00-01:04.00] [CAMERA] Close-up of Juliana exhaling a deep breath of relief, smiling gently.
[01:04.00-01:05.60] [CAMERA] Close-up of the mother looking up at Juliana with overwhelming gratitude.
[01:04.20-01:05.50] PEASANT MOTHER (Tearful, Grateful): "You saved him."
[01:05.60-01:08.50] [CAMERA] Medium close-up of Juliana grasping the mother's hand with warm modesty.
[01:05.80-01:08.20] JULIANA (Soft, Gracious): "The herbs did their work. Let him rest."
[01:08.00-01:10.50] [ACTION] Juliana places a comforting hand over the mother's hands.
[01:10.50-01:13.00] [ACTION] The mother gathers her sleeping son in her arms and steps back toward the rainy doorway.
[01:11.00-01:14.80] [CAMERA] Medium shot from inside the cottage framing the mother standing at the open door looking back.
[01:11.20-01:14.80] PEASANT MOTHER (Reverent, Vowing): "I will tell the village what you did. They will never forget you."
[01:14.50-01:15.50] [ACTION] The mother exits into the rainy twilight as Alexander pushes the door shut.
[01:14.80-01:17.50] [CAMERA] Close-up of Alexander turning from the door, his expression deeply troubled.
[01:15.10-01:17.50] ALEXANDER (Stern, Warning): "You cannot let the whole village start talking about you."
[01:17.50-01:19.50] [CAMERA] Medium close-up of Juliana placing the mortar back onto the table, unflinching.
[01:17.60-01:19.40] JULIANA (Defiant, Principled): "A child's life matters more than gossip."
[01:19.60-01:21.60] ALEXANDER (Dark, Cautionary): "Gossip has a way of becoming dangerous."

events.text: Low-angle tracking shot of heavy carriage wheels churning violently through the muddy, waterlogged track.
Squelch of mud and the grinding rattle of carriage wheels under heavy rain.
Medium two-shot of Juliana and Alexander standing outside the rustic stone cottage, watching the incoming carriage with tense apprehension.
Juliana wrings a damp rag in her hands, her face etched with rising dread, while Alexander stands guard beside her.
Tight shot tilting up as polished black boots step down directly into the muck, revealing Gerald clad in an opulent burgundy double-breasted coat.
Gerald buttons his coat, smug self-satisfaction radiating from his expression.
Medium shot of a uniformed Constable descending from the carriage, firmly gripping a wooden truncheon.
Medium tracking shot as Juliana steps defensively toward Gerald, her face full of shock and anger.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "Gerald? What are you doing here?"
Wide two-shot across the puddle-strewn ground between Gerald and Juliana against the misty landscape.

events.speaker: GERALD
events.text: "I came for something that belongs to me."
Close-up of Clarissa peering from the carriage window in her violet silk gown, a venomous, triumphant smile curling her lips.
Close-up of Juliana, her anger flaring as she gestures sharply.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "You have already taken enough from me. Leave!"
Medium close-up of Gerald pointing an accusatory finger, his composure snapping into hostile anger.

events.speaker: GERALD
events.text: "Your husband stole my gold pocket watch!"
Close-up of Juliana recoiling in utter disbelief.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "What? When?"
Close-up of Gerald narrowing his eyes vindictively.

events.speaker: GERALD
events.text: "The last time I came here."
Medium shot of Juliana scoffing, stepping forward as Alexander stands motionless behind her.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "You never even entered the cottage!"
Close-up of Gerald smirking with condescending amusement.

events.speaker: GERALD
events.text: "Then you should have nothing to fear from a search."
Three-shot of Alexander, Juliana, and Gerald in the bleak drizzle.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "Alexander would never steal from you."
Low-angle shot of Gerald throwing his head back in arrogant, mocking laughter.

events.speaker: GERALD
events.text: "Of course you would defend him. You married a beggar!"

events.text: Medium shot looking out the doorway as Juliana steps aside and the Constable barges past into the dimly lit cottage.
Heavy thud of boots entering wooden floorboards, followed by forceful banging of furniture.
The Constable begins violently overturning crates and dumping contents across the floor.
Medium low-angle shot of Juliana dropping to her knees, frantically trying to salvage bundles of dried herbs scattering across the boards.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "Stop! Those are my mother's medicines!"
The Constable aggressively pulls folded bed linens from a shelf and hurls them onto the damp floor.
Low-angle close-up of Juliana crawling on the floor, looking up with tears streaming down her cheeks.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "Please! There is nothing here!"
Close-up of the Constable's hands flipping open a small wooden keepsake box on a work table.

events.speaker: CONSTABLE
events.text: "Then you have nothing to fear."
Low-angle close-up of Juliana clutching the fallen linens to her chest, her voice breaking.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "Those are all I have left!"
Medium shot of Gerald leaning casually against the cottage doorframe, looking around with contemptuous disgust.

events.speaker: GERALD
events.text: "Stand aside. Look at this place. A perfect hiding hole for a thief."

events.speaker: ALEXANDER

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "But one blow would destroy her life."

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "That is his coat!"

events.text: Medium shot of the Constable raising a set of heavy iron handcuffs, addressing Alexander sternly in front of the stone hearth.

events.speaker: CONSTABLE
events.text: "Put out your hands, veteran. You are under arrest for theft."
Medium shot of Juliana swiftly moving in front of Alexander, placing herself defiantly between him and the Constable's outstretched handcuffs.
Juliana steps firmly forward, shielding Alexander with her body.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "No! That watch was not in his coat!"
Close-up of the Constable narrowing his eyes coldly at Juliana.

events.speaker: CONSTABLE
events.text: "I found it there myself."
Close-up of Juliana glaring back with unwavering conviction.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "Then someone put it there!"
Medium full shot of Gerald framed in the open cottage doorway holding his riding crop, stepping inside with a patronizing, gloating grin.

events.speaker: GERALD
events.text: "The proof is in his coat, Juliana. A valuable pocket watch doesn't just walk into a beggar's pocket."
Close-up of Alexander, his scarred brow furrowed in dark, quiet defiance.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "I have never touched your property."

events.speaker: GERALD
events.text: "Then perhaps your wife should explain why it was found in your coat."
Medium shot of Gerald pointing his riding crop toward them, with Clarissa hovering behind him in her violet silk gown.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "You planted it!"
Juliana lunges a step forward, jabbing an accusing finger toward Gerald.
Medium shot of Clarissa gliding past Gerald, a venomous, amused smile playing upon her lips.

events.speaker: CLARISSA
events.text: "Oh, dear sister..."
Tight shot of Alexander's hand clenching into a tight, trembling fist against the glow of the roaring fireplace.

events.speaker: CLARISSA
events.text: "...still defending your broken scrap of a man?"
Close-up of Alexander glaring daggers at Clarissa.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "Name your price, Clarissa. I know you."
Medium close-up of Juliana, her eyes narrowing with sharp perception.
Medium close-up of Clarissa smiling with vicious delight.

events.speaker: CLARISSA
events.text: "You always were clever, Juliana. Always searching for some way to escape."

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "Juliana, look at those thorns. You cannot do this."
Medium close-up of Alexander and Juliana facing each other, his chained wrists held between them.
Close-up on Juliana's hooded face, her eyes filled with resolute sorrow.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "I must."
Close-up on Alexander, his combat scar stark against his pained expression.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "They will tear your hands apart."
Low-angle shot looking up at Gerald and Clarissa leaning over the stone balustrade, smirking down with cruel amusement.
Close-up of Juliana looking up into Alexander's eyes with tender courage.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "I will be fine."

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "I would rather face the gallows than watch you hurt yourself for me."
Two-shot framing Alexander leaning down toward Juliana, fighting against his bonds.
Close-up of Gerald chuckling smugly on the terrace above, crossing his arms.
Tight close-up of Juliana gently clasping Alexander's handcuffed hands, gazing up at him with unyielding love.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "You stood beside me when everyone else abandoned me. I will not abandon you now."
Juliana releases his hands and turns toward the briar thicket. Alexander stretches out his chained hands, attempting to hold her back, but the Constable restrains him.
Medium shot behind Juliana as she walks toward the vast expanse of frozen briars.

events.speaker: CLARISSA
events.text: "Careful, sister."

events.speaker: CLARISSA
events.text: "That garden has swallowed better women than you."

boundary_events.text: Wide shot looking down from the stone terrace. Gerald and Clarissa stand elevated on the balustrade, while Juliana, Alexander in handcuffs, and the Constable stand before the dense briar garden.
Alexander turns toward Juliana, his manacled hands trembling as he grips her arm.
Low-angle shot of Clarissa smirking down over the carved stone balustrade.

events.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
events.text: "I said, move!"
Low-angle medium shot of the Thug with Cap gripping his weapon with both hands and roaring into the night air.
Medium close-up of Alexander remaining completely motionless, his jaw clenched in stoic calm.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "Alexander..."
Close-up of Juliana kneeling in the mud against the ruined planter, clutching her bandaged hands to her chest in trembling fear.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "Stay behind me."
Medium action shot as the Thug with Cap lunges forward with his weapon raised high.

events.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
events.text: "Aaargh!"
The thug swings the club down with full force, but Alexander catches the weapon mid-air in his bare hand with chilling ease.
Heavy blunt impact of a solid hand gripping wood.
Close-up of the Thug with Cap staring in wide-eyed terror as Alexander grips the bar and wrenches it away effortlessly.
Alexander strikes the thug across the chest and slams him violently into the muddy ground beside the stone wall.
Heavy thud of a body crashing into soil and wood.
Close-up of Juliana watching in breathless astonishment.

events.speaker: BALD THUG
events.text: "Aaargh!"
Medium tracking shot as the Bald Thug charges in with a shout, only for Alexander to pivot and seize him by the neck, hurling him across the garden path.
Loud wooden scrape and crunch as the Bald Thug slides across the planks into the fence.

events.speaker: THIRD THUG
events.text: "Stay back!"
Medium shot of the Third Thug backing away nervously, raising a blunt rod with trembling arms before lunging.
Alexander deflects the strike with his forearm, drives a swift counter-blow into the thug's torso, and spins him violently to the ground.
Solid bone-and-fist impact followed by a groaning thud.
Wide cinematic shot under the full moon. Alexander towers over the three writhing thugs groaning in the mud as Juliana looks up from her knees.
Low-angle close-up of Juliana looking up at Alexander, tears glistening on her mud-splattered cheeks in profound relief.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "Alexander..."
Medium shot over Juliana's shoulder as Alexander turns his gaze toward her, his stern demeanor softening with concern.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "Are you hurt?"

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "Only my hands."

events.text: Close-up on Juliana's bandaged hand reaching into the dark earth of a battered planter box.
Juliana gently lifts a tiny, delicate white daisy clinging to its exposed roots out of the soil, cupping it in her palm.
Medium close-up tilting up to Juliana's face, bruised and tear-streaked yet filled with fragile hope.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "Some of them survived."
Low-angle medium shot of Alexander repairing the broken wooden fence with a heavy iron hammer.
Rhythmic, heavy thuds of an iron hammer pounding into weathered wood.
Alexander firmly drives nails into a fractured fence post, his brow furrowed with focused determination.
Wide shot framing Juliana kneeling on the wet cobblestones in the foreground while Alexander stands by the fence behind her, lowering his hammer.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "Thank you."
Close-up of Alexander turning toward her, his scarred face stoic and intense.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "For what?"
Close-up of Juliana looking up at him with deep emotional vulnerability, her eyes shimmering with tears.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "For standing between me and those men."
Close-up of Alexander, his piercing blue-grey eyes fixed upon her with absolute conviction.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "I would do it again."
Close-up of Juliana, her lips parting as her voice wavers with emotion.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "Even if there were ten of them?"

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "As long as I draw breath..."
Tracking shot following Alexander as he strides across the muddy garden and approaches Juliana.
Alexander drops to one knee before Juliana, gently taking her trembling, bandaged hands into his large, weathered palms.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "...no one will hurt you again."
Close-up on Juliana's tear-filled face, overwhelmed by his fierce devotion.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "You cannot promise that."

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "I just did."

boundary_events.text: Extreme close-up of Alexander's intense, protective gaze locking onto hers.

events.text: Close-up of their joined hands, his rugged, scarred fingers wrapping securely around her bandaged fingers.
Alexander squeezes Juliana's hands reassuringly as she rests her fingertips against his skin. The scene fades to black.
Medium shot in the warm, flickering firelight of the stone cottage. Juliana kneels on the stone floor beside a washbasin of water while Alexander sits quietly in a chair beside the blazing hearth.
Juliana wrings out a clean linen cloth from the basin and tenderly dabs at the fresh cuts and abrasions on the back of Alexander's right hand.
Close-up of Juliana's bandaged hands delicately pressing the white cloth against Alexander's wounded knuckles.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "You were bleeding last night."
Medium close-up showing Alexander gazing down at her, his expression softening with unspoken affection as he gently takes hold of her wrist.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "So were you."
Close-up of Juliana looking up into his eyes, a faint, tender smile gracing her lips.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "You make it very difficult to argue with you."

events.text: Juliana coughs, her eyes widening in immediate alarm as the smell of burning wood fills her lungs.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "Alexander!"

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "Alexander!"

events.text: "Alexander..."

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "What happened?"

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "Fire."

events.text: Full shot of Juliana and Alexander standing side by side amidst the charred, smoldering wreckage of their destroyed cottage, thick smoke rising behind them into the overcast sky.
Juliana clutches her mother's scorched leather-bound herbal book against her chest, her face streaked with soot as she stares at the ruin in disbelief.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "This was our home."
Close-up of the blackened, heat-damaged leather ledger held in Juliana's linen-bandaged hands.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "My mother's book almost burned with it."
Juliana tenderly lifts a scorched corner of parchment, revealing the surviving botanical drawing of medicinal herbs inside.
Medium shot of Alexander looking down at Juliana with quiet, stoic concern.
Medium shot of three villagers approaching through the burnt clearing: an elder villager carrying folded wool blankets, followed by a man and woman holding loaves of baked bread.

events.speaker: ELDER VILLAGER
events.text: "My lady. You cannot stay here."
Close-up of Juliana's tearful, soot-stained face as she listens.

events.speaker: ELDER VILLAGER
events.text: "There is an old barn near the village. It is empty."
The elder villager steps closer, resting a gentle, reassuring hand on Juliana's shoulder.

events.speaker: ELDER VILLAGER
events.text: "Take it."

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "We cannot ask the village to feed us."

events.speaker: ELDER VILLAGER
events.text: "You saved my son's life."
Close-up of the elder villager's rough, weathered hands offering a fresh loaf of artisan bread wrapped in cloth against the smoking timber ruins.

events.speaker: ELDER VILLAGER
events.text: "You saved mine, too."
Close-up of Juliana, tears spilling down her cheeks as she smiles through her grief.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "Thank you."
Alexander steps forward and accepts the thick folded blankets and a wooden bucket from the villager.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "We will not forget this kindness."

events.speaker: ELDER VILLAGER
events.text: "Neither will the village."

events.text: "Tell me what is happening in Ashburg."

events.speaker: INFORMANT
events.text: "Lord Sterling's influence has grown since your disappearance. He has men in the county offices, the courts, even among the household staff."

events.speaker: INFORMANT
events.text: "Rupert has become the face of Ashburg. He sits in your father's room, signs your estate papers, gives orders as though the title already belongs to him."
Slow push-in on Alexander's rugged, scarred face, his jaw tightening with simmering rage as he listens.
Medium shot of the bald informant standing among the towering trees, reporting solemnly.

events.speaker: INFORMANT
events.text: "And Lady Catherine, she behaves as though she is already the future duchess."
Close-up of the informant, his voice dropping into urgent, discreet concern.

events.speaker: INFORMANT
events.text: "But they have separated her from the household. She is watched constantly. Every letter she sends is checked. Every visitor is questioned."
Extreme close-up of Alexander's right hand clenching into a powerful, trembling fist at his coat seam, veins bulging with restrained violence.

events.speaker: INFORMANT
events.text: "There are almost no loyal servants left around her."
Low-angle shot past Alexander toward the informant.

events.speaker: INFORMANT
events.text: "The people who served your family for years have been dismissed, frightened away, or replaced."
Alexander lifts his gaze toward the cold forest canopy, his breathing heavy with profound anguish.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "My mother is a prisoner in her own house."

events.speaker: INFORMANT
events.text: "And everyone believes you are dead."
Extreme close-up of Alexander's scarred eye and grimly set mouth.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "Then let them believe it a little longer."

events.speaker: INFORMANT
events.text: "And when we have the proof?"

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "Then Ashburg will remember who it belongs to."

candidates.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.text: Medium wide shot of the lavish drawing room. CATHERINE, dressed in an ornate lilac regency gown and white satin gloves, gracefully pours hot tea from an ornate silver teapot, while RUPERT stands elegantly by the tall window.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "Two lumps of sugar, Rupert?"

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "Or has your sudden climb to power sweetened your taste already?"
Close-up of Catherine stirring her tea with a silver spoon, lifting her gaze with a haughty smirk.

events.speaker: RUPERT
events.text: "Only if it sweetens your disposition, Catherine."
Medium shot tracking Rupert as he steps forward from the hearth, adjusting his dark leather gloves with an air of absolute triumph.

events.speaker: RUPERT
events.text: "The estate is practically ours."

events.speaker: RUPERT
events.text: "The succession papers are being finalized as we speak."
Medium close-up of Catherine raising the porcelain teacup to her lips, her expression turning sharp and dismissive.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "'Practically' is a word for beggars. I do not marry a practical Duke."

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "I marry the Lord of Ashbury."
Medium shot of Rupert striding toward the tea table, leaning forward with predatory conviction.

events.speaker: RUPERT
events.text: "And so you shall."

events.speaker: RUPERT
events.text: "Once my cousin Alexander's death is formally sealed by the Crown..."

events.speaker: RUPERT
events.text: "...the title is mine."

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "And what of the Dowager? The old woman still breathes."
Close-up of Catherine lowering her teacup, her icy blue eyes narrowing in calculated concern.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "Her shadow still hangs over this house."

events.speaker: RUPERT
events.text: "Her health fails more each day. The physicians are baffled."
Tight close-up of Rupert's face as a sinister grin spreads across his features.

events.speaker: RUPERT
events.text: "They call it a wasting of the lungs."

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "How tragic. The slow, quiet decline."

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "How much longer can the frail thing survive?"

boundary_events.text: Close-up side profile of Catherine bringing the teacup to her lips, savoring his words with chilling detachment.

Medium close-up tilting down on JULIANA kneeling in the straw beside a rustic wooden crate, sorting sprigs of dried lavender and sage into a woven basket. Her hands are bound in linen bandages from the recent fire.
The barn door opens, revealing daylight outside. SEAMUS, an older weathered villager in a waistcoat, carries a wooden bucket inside, his expression etched with deep sorrow and concern.

events.speaker: SEAMUS
events.text: "Let me take that basket, Lady Juliana."

events.speaker: SEAMUS
events.text: "Your palms are still raw from the fire. You shouldn't be working in this freezing draft."
Seamus reaches down to take the handle of the basket from her.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "If I stop, Seamus, the lung fever in the valley wins."
Close-up of Juliana looking up at Seamus, her smudged face fierce with unyielding determination as she holds firmly onto the basket.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.text: "Lady Juliana! Please! You have to help me, Toby is dying!"
Lady Juliana hurries over, placing her bandaged hands reassuringly on Prudence's trembling shoulders.

events.speaker: LADY JULIANA
events.text: "Oh dear. Breathe. Tell me what has happened."
Medium close-up of Lady Juliana looking into Prudence's tearful face with compassionate urgency.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.text: "My little brother Toby... his chest is burning! He cannot breathe!"
Close-up of Prudence weeping, clutching her hands to her chest in agony.

events.speaker: LADY JULIANA
events.text: "Tell me what the apothecary said. Did he not give you medicine?"
Close-up of Lady Juliana, her brow furrowing with concern.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.text: "He shut the door in my face because we have no silver!"
Close-up of Prudence, her face twisted in bitter anguish as she gestures back toward the rain-soaked outdoors.
Wide shot of Lady Juliana and Prudence facing each other inside the wooden barn, dust motes drifting in the pale light.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.text: "The manor doctor laughed! He said village boys are not worth his time!"
Medium profile shot of Lady Juliana looking down at her bandaged hands, holding Prudence's hand with somber heartache.

events.speaker: LADY JULIANA
events.text: "We have no clinic now."

events.speaker: LADY JULIANA
events.text: "Our cottage is ashes. I have nothing left but this coltsfoot."
Prudence drops desperately to her knees onto the hay-strewn barn floor, clasping her hands in tearful supplication.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.text: "He is only seven! If you do not come, he will die! You are his only hope, Lady Juliana!"
High-angle looking down at Prudence kneeling before Lady Juliana, pleading upward.

events.text: "His skin is burning hot."

events.speaker: LADY JULIANA
events.text: "Prudence, fetch hot water immediately!"

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.text: "Yes! Right away, I will get it!"
Medium shot of Prudence nodding rapidly, rushing toward the stone hearth.
Prudence wraps a cloth around the iron handle of the steaming kettle resting over the hearth fire and lifts it.
Close-up top-down view of Lady Juliana's bandaged fingers gently touching an ink illustration of chamomile flowers in the open ledger.

events.speaker: LADY JULIANA
events.text: "I cannot let my own weariness stop me. This boy needs my mother's knowledge."
Lady Juliana crushes dried herbal leaves into a dark wooden bowl between her bandaged hands, then pours steaming water over them from the kettle.
Close-up of hot water pouring into the bowl, releasing aromatic vapors from the dried herbs.
Lady Juliana sits beside the pallet and brings the steaming herbal bowl close to Toby's face while Prudence cradles his shoulders.
Medium shot of Lady Juliana, Prudence, and Toby huddled together by the warm glow of the fire.

events.speaker: LADY JULIANA
events.text: "Lift his shoulders, Prudence. Hold the steam close. Let him inhale."

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.text: "Like this? Toby, breathe it in, sweet boy."
Close-up of Prudence supporting Toby's head, whispering tenderly into his ear.

events.speaker: LADY JULIANA
events.text: "Yes, just like that. Keep breathing, Toby. Let the vapor clear your chest."
Close-up of Lady Juliana gently waving her hand to direct the medicinal steam toward Toby's nose and mouth.
Close-up of Toby's face relaxing, his chest falling still and calm.
Toby's strained wheezing eases into quiet, rhythmic breathing as he slips into peaceful sleep on his pillow.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.text: "Oh, thank God! His chest is quiet! The rattling has stopped!"
Close-up of Prudence covering her mouth in overwhelmed relief, tears streaming down her face.
Lady Juliana pulls the plaid wool blanket snug over Toby's chest, smiling softly with profound relief.

events.speaker: LADY JULIANA
events.text: "Keep him warm. Give him three drops of this coltsfoot tea every morning."
Medium shot of Lady Juliana sitting on a stool beside Toby's bedside, placing a cup of coltsfoot tea on a small wooden table.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.text: "You saved him. The grand doctors left him to choke, but you..."
Medium close-up of Prudence looking at Lady Juliana with awe and boundless gratitude, her hands clasped in front of her.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.text: "I have no money, Lady Juliana, but I swear on my life, I will do anything to repay you."
Lady Juliana takes Prudence's trembling hands into hers, smiling with heartfelt warmth.
Close-up of Lady Juliana comforting Prudence warmly.

events.speaker: LADY JULIANA
events.text: "Your brother's breath is payment enough for me, Prudence."

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.text: "At the grand manor, they ignore us. They only care about their own luxury."
Low-angle shot past sleeping Toby toward Prudence standing in the room, her expression darkening with anger.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.text: "But their gold cannot buy them health."
Lady Juliana turns sharply, her eyes widening with sudden recognition.
Close-up of Lady Juliana looking directly into Prudence's eyes with startled concern.

events.speaker: LADY JULIANA
events.text: "What do you mean? Is someone ill? The Dowager Duchess?"
Low-angle cut to Toby sleeping peacefully as the fire crackles behind him.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.text: "She is dying, Lady Juliana."

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.text: "A strange, mysterious illness is eating her away."

events.text: Prudence rushes up behind Lady Juliana, pulling her into the shelter of the stone archway.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.text: "Keep your head down. If anyone recognizes you, everything is over."
Close-up of Lady Juliana leaning back against the rough stone wall, whispering back firmly.

events.speaker: LADY JULIANA
events.text: "No one will recognize me dressed like this."
Medium close-up of Prudence glancing nervously toward the courtyard before fixing her gaze on Juliana.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.text: "This is Ashburton Manor. The housekeeper watches everyone. Lady Catherine watches everyone, and Lord Rupert..."
Close-up of Lady Juliana cutting in with fierce, unyielding conviction.

events.speaker: LADY JULIANA
events.text: "The Duchess is dying."
Low-angle shot looking up at Lady Juliana and Prudence standing beneath the looming stone facade of the manor.

events.speaker: LADY JULIANA
events.text: "I saved Toby. I can save her."
Close-up on Prudence, her eyes wide with dread.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.text: "And if they discover who you are?"
Close-up on Lady Juliana holding her gaze steadily.

events.speaker: LADY JULIANA
events.text: "Then I will face that when she is breathing again."
Medium two-shot outside the heavy wooden servant entrance door.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.text: "Then forget you were ever a lady."

events.speaker: LADY JULIANA
events.text: "Today, I am only a maid."

events.text: Slow tracking shot into the cavernous, shadowy bedchamber. In the center stands an ornate four-poster canopy bed draped in pale silk where a frail, silver-haired figure lies motionless.
Labored, raspy, shallow breathing echoing in the quiet room.
Lady Juliana hurries inside, sets the wooden bucket onto the floor, and rushes to the bedside.

events.speaker: LADY JULIANA
events.text: "Your Grace?"
Close-up of the Dowager Duchess lying propped on pillows, her face gaunt, ashen, and drenched in cold sweat, her eyes half-fluttering.

events.speaker: LADY JULIANA
events.text: "Do not speak."
Medium close-up of Lady Juliana taking the Duchess's fragile, cold hands into her own.
Close-up of Lady Juliana checking the Duchess's pulse and gently pressing her fingertips against the Duchess's chest and neck, her herbalist instincts taking over.
Lady Juliana's eyes widen with sudden, horrifying realization.

events.speaker: LADY JULIANA
events.text: "This isn't ordinary fever."
The Dowager Duchess suddenly gasps violently for breath, convulsing weakly as her eyes snap open in agony.
Close-up of the Duchess gasping in sudden spasms.
Intense two-shot as Lady Juliana leans in close, gripping the Duchess's shoulder with urgent desperation.

events.speaker: LADY JULIANA
events.text: "Who has been treating you?"

candidates.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.text: "Juliana, we cannot stay for long. Someone will come."
Medium close-up of Prudence holding a brass candlestick with trembling hands, glancing nervously toward the doorway.
Medium shot of Lady Juliana gently lifting the frail, trembling hands of the Dowager Duchess resting atop the linen covers.
Juliana cradles the Duchess's frail hands in hers, inspecting her fingers with furrowed brows.
Close-up of the Duchess's fingertips, revealing pronounced dark, purplish-black discoloration beneath the nails.

events.speaker: LADY JULIANA
events.text: "How long has she been like this?"

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.text: "Weeks."
Medium shot of Prudence leaning against the bedpost, tears glistening in her eyes.
High-angle two-shot as Lady Juliana leans closer over the gasping Duchess, gently touching her parched lips.
Close-up on Lady Juliana's concerned face as she withdraws her finger from the Duchess's mouth.

events.speaker: LADY JULIANA
events.text: "Her mouth is terribly dry."
Medium shot as Lady Juliana presses her fingertips gently against the Duchess's wrist, feeling for a pulse.

events.speaker: LADY JULIANA
events.text: "Her pulse is weak."
Close-up of Prudence holding the flickering candle, crying openly in distress.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.text: "The physician said her heart is failing."
Close-up of the Dowager Duchess gasping hoarsely for air, her throat straining as she weakly fights to breathe.
Duchess's raspy, labored inhalation.
Medium shot of Lady Juliana standing upright, her expression hardening with fierce skepticism.

events.speaker: LADY JULIANA
events.text: "No."
Medium shot panning down as Juliana reaches into her deep apron pocket and pulls out a worn, leather-bound notebook.

events.speaker: LADY JULIANA
events.text: "This is not simply old age."

events.text: Medium shot of the noblewoman holding the riding crop upright, regarding Juliana with disdainful authority.

events.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
events.text: "Who are you?"

events.speaker: LADY JULIANA
events.text: "Juliana, my lady. I was hired for the winter cleaning."
Medium close-up of Juliana, her gaze lowered deferentially beside the carved wooden bedpost.
Medium shot of the noblewoman, her chin tilted up in icy condescension.

events.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
events.text: "And who gave you permission to enter this chamber?"
Close-up of the frail Dowager Duchess lying pale and unconscious against the white pillows, gasping weakly for air.
Behind her grey skirt, Juliana quickly slips the small glass remedy vial into her apron pocket with her charcoal-dusted fingers.
Close-up on Juliana's hand swiftly concealing the medicine bottle.

events.speaker: LADY JULIANA
events.text: "I heard her. I thought Her Grace needed help."
Medium shot of Juliana facing the noblewoman, maintaining a calm, protective facade.

events.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
events.text: "You thought? A new maid thinks she knows better than the physicians?"
Two-shot framing the noblewoman looking down at Juliana, bursting into mocking laughter.
Close-up of Juliana's resolute expression, her eyes flashing with righteous urgency.

events.speaker: LADY JULIANA
events.text: "She is suffering."
Tight close-up of the noblewoman's face twisting into a malicious sneer.

events.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
events.text: "Then let her suffer."
Close-up of Juliana recoiling slightly in shock at the blatant cruelty.

events.speaker: LADY JULIANA
events.text: "I cannot do that."
The noblewoman suddenly rears back her riding crop and strikes Juliana violently across the torso.
A sharp, stinging whip crack as the riding crop makes harsh contact.
Juliana gasps in pain, clutching her stomach and bending over as she absorbs the brutal strike.
Medium shot of Juliana hunched over in pain, clutching her abdomen.

events.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
events.text: "You are a maid."
Low-angle shot looking past the bedpost toward the Duchess, whose trembling hand reaches out limply.

events.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
events.text: "Not a physician. Not a lady."

boundary_events.text: The noblewoman halts in the center of the chamber, tapping her riding crop against her gloved palm as her cold gaze sweeps across the two maids.

events.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
events.text: "Every stone. Perhaps when your hands are black enough, you will finally remember what you are."
Extreme close-up two-shot as the noblewoman steps unnervingly close to Juliana's face, whispering with sadistic relish.
Juliana slowly drops to her knees on the cold flagstones before the soot-filled fireplace.
Medium shot of Juliana sinking to her knees, her face grim and composed.
Prudence steps toward the noblewoman in distress, her hands clasped tightly.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.text: "My lady—"
Close-up of Prudence's anxious, trembling face.
The noblewoman whips around sharply, thrusting the tip of her riding crop directly into Prudence's face.
Medium close-up of the noblewoman baring her teeth in rage, aiming the crop threateningly.

events.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
events.text: "Do you want the same punishment?"
Close-up of Prudence flinching in terror, lowering her eyes immediately.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.text: "No, my lady."
Juliana grips a coarse scrubbing brush with both hands and begins vigorously scraping the thick black ash across the hearthstones.
Close-up shot of Juliana's soot-covered hands fiercely scrubbing the black ash along the stone floor.
Rhythmic, harsh rasping sound of bristles scraping against stone.
Medium shot of the noblewoman leaning casually against the wooden doorframe, watching Juliana toil with smug condescension.

events.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
events.text: "That is where clever little servants belong."
Medium profile shot of Juliana kneeling by the hearth in the dim window light, scrubbing steadily.

events.speaker: LADY JULIANA
events.text: "Let her think I am only a maid."

Juliana pauses scrubbing. Her soot-caked fingers reach into the deep pocket of her apron, carefully feeling the worn leather cover of her mother's remedy journal and the glass dropper bottle securely concealed within.
Close-up of Juliana's soot-stained hand touching the hidden remedy book and the antidote vial inside her apron pocket.

events.speaker: LADY JULIANA
events.text: "Let her believe I am ignorant."
Juliana raises her head. Smudges of dark soot stain her fair cheek, but her piercing blue eyes burn with unwavering defiance and unyielding resolve as she stares toward the hallway.

events.speaker: LADY JULIANA
events.text: "I will return. You cannot stop the healer."

boundary_events.text: Wide shot of the vast soot-stained stone fireplace. The noblewoman turns back toward Juliana, crop held at her side.
Tight close-up of Juliana's soot-streaked face turning slowly toward the chamber exit, her jaw set firm as dramatic music builds to a powerful crescendo.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "Juliana."
Close-up of Juliana stopping abruptly, her expression guarded and weary.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "Why are you walking like that?"
Medium close-up of Juliana clutching the collar of her cloak with trembling fingers.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "I am tired. That is all."
Alexander steps forward and reaches out, his gloved hand firmly grasping her left shoulder. Juliana winces sharply and gasps in sudden pain.
Two-shot profile of Alexander grabbing Juliana's shoulder as she recoils.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "You're hurt."
Close-up of Juliana gritting her teeth against the pain, shaking her head.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "It is nothing."
Alexander's gloved fingers pull back the torn fabric of her cloak and sleeve, revealing a raw, bloody welt slashing across her bare shoulder.
Tight close-up of the fresh riding-crop laceration cut across Juliana's shoulder.
Close-up of Alexander's scarred face darkening with volatile fury, his jaw tightening.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "Who did this?"
Medium close-up of Juliana averting her eyes, her head bowed in quiet resignation.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "It does not matter."
Tight shot of Alexander, his eyes burning with intense anger.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "Who?"
Alexander steps directly into her space, firmly taking her hand in his.
Close-up of Juliana looking up into his eyes, whispering the truth.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "Lady Catherine."
Close-up of Alexander, his gaze piercing and hard.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "Where did you meet her?"

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "I was in the wrong chamber. I was punished as a maid."
Close-up of Juliana recounting the incident.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "What were you doing there?"

candidates.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
events.text: "This ring..."
Low-angle medium close-up of the Dowager Duchess lying propped against her pillows, gripping Juliana's wrist firmly as she gazes up in desperate demand.

events.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
events.text: "Look at me, girl. Who gave this to you?"
Medium shot of Juliana in her maid's apron, startled and anxious as she answers.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "My husband. He gave it to me when we wed."
Low angle on the Dowager Duchess, her eyes burning with intensity.

events.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
events.text: "He is no commoner. What does he do?"
Close-up of Juliana, trying to keep her composure.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "He is a soldier. A veteran from the Peninsula."
Medium two-shot as the Duchess leans forward slightly, staring at the ring between their joined hands.

events.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
events.text: "That is no ordinary band. It bears the Ashbourne crest."
Close-up on Juliana, shaking her head in disbelief and growing confusion.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "No. He lives in a barn. He has nothing but his word."
Low-angle shot on the Duchess, tears welling in her eyes as grief and shock overtake her.

events.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
events.text: "My lost son wore that exact ring. He went to war..."
Close-up of Juliana's eyes widening in stunned revelation.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "Your son? He told me he was only a sergeant."
Side-angle medium shot of the bed, the Duchess holding onto Juliana's forearm with fierce insistence.

events.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
events.text: "My lost son wore that ring!"
Close-up of Juliana looking down with compassionate concern.

events.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
events.text: "Did your husband serve beside him?"

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "He never spoke of his officers. He only spoke of survival."
Close-up of the Duchess gazing up at Juliana, her voice barely a whisper.

events.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
events.text: "What is your husband's name?"
Loud, violent pounding echoes on the wooden double doors.
Juliana gasps, snapping her head toward the entrance in alarm.
The heavy mahogany double doors burst open, revealing the Blond Nobleman flanked by Lady Catherine and a royal guard in uniform.
Wide shot framing the open doorway as the aristocrats step into the dimly lit hallway.
Medium shot of Lady Catherine in her lavish cream gown and tiara, scowling with arrogant disdain.

events.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
events.text: "What is that maid doing in Her Grace's private chamber?"

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "She needed help."

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "Look at her, Rupert."

events.text: "Soot on her face..."

events.text: "...herbs in her pockets..."

events.text: "...a secret medicine in her hand."

events.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN

events.text: "You are merely confused."

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "How convenient that the only person who can prove the poison exists..."

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "...is the maid who claims to have discovered it."

events.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
events.text: "Take her away before she poisons the rest of this house."

Catherine ruthlessly yanks the silver locket off Juliana's neck.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "No!"
Medium close-up of Catherine holding up the oval silver and amethyst pendant, inspecting it with disdain.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "Where did a gutter rat like you find a silver locket?"

events.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
events.text: "You have a rat in your cellar, Rupert. And the servants are beginning to smell it."
Close-up of Rupert defensive and agitated.

events.speaker: RUPERT
events.text: "The Ashcroft girl is locked tight. Nobody knows she is down there."
Medium close-up of the Elder Nobleman fixing Rupert with a piercing, contemptuous glare.

events.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
events.text: "The kitchen maids are whispering. They see the soup bowls returned unwiped. They see your guards outside the lower grates."
Medium shot of Rupert looking down, nervously pulling at his black leather gloves as dread creeps over his face.

events.speaker: RUPERT
events.text: "She knows the Duchess was poisoned."
Tight close-up on the Elder Nobleman's unyielding eyes narrowing in cold calculation.
Tight close-up of Rupert swallows hard, breathless with dread.

events.speaker: RUPERT
events.text: "If she speaks..."
The Elder Nobleman thrusts the gold knob of his walking stick directly against Rupert's chest, pinning him against the wall.
Medium two-shot as the Elder Nobleman lunges forward aggressively, stepping into Rupert's personal space.

events.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
events.text: "Then make certain she isn't! A peasant weed, Rupert! You do not store weeds in your cellar, you burn them!"
Low-angle close-up of Rupert gasping softly, intimidated by the cane pressed firmly beneath his cravat.

events.speaker: RUPERT
events.text: "What are you suggesting?"

events.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
events.text: "We stop hiding the prisoner."

boundary_events.text: Two-shot profile of the Elder Nobleman facing Rupert in the vaulted corridor.
Medium shot as the Elder Nobleman withdraws his cane and turns sharply toward the library doors.

candidates.scene_heading: INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "Look at you."
Low-angle close-up of Juliana looking up from the stone floor, her gaze hardening despite her fear.
Tight close-up of Catherine's face, bathed in the orange flickering glow of the red-hot branding iron, smiling with pure malice.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "The great Lady Juliana Ashcroft."
Over-the-shoulder wide shot past Catherine looking down at Juliana shackled helplessly on the wet stone floor.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "Chained in a dungeon like a common criminal."
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes glistening with unshed tears, speaking with quiet defiance.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "You seem very pleased."
Low-angle shot looking up at Catherine towering over Juliana, holding the glowing poker at her side.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "I am."
Extreme close-up of the bent, white-hot tip of the poker radiating heat, with Catherine's face blurred in the background as she gazes down with predatory pleasure.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "Because this is what you were always meant to be."
Over-the-shoulder medium shot focusing on Juliana as Catherine presents the charred, singed pages of the botanical book.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "Your family dressed you like a lady. They educated you. They gave you a respectable name."
Close-up of Catherine's face breaking into an arrogant, haughty laugh.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "[chuckles] And still you became a disgrace."
Tight close-up of Juliana's fierce, unwavering gaze as she retorts without hesitation.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "I became a disgrace when I refused to become cruel."
Close-up of Catherine scowling, cutting back to a shot of Juliana's bare, chained feet locked in iron manacles against the cold stone floor.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "No. You became a disgrace when Gerald left you standing at the altar."
Medium shot from floor level looking up at Catherine leaning closer, savoring Juliana's humiliation.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "Do you remember?"
Juliana stares up, her breathing steadying as she refuses to break under Catherine's barbs.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "Everyone saw you. Everyone watched him chose Clarisse."
Close-up of the red-hot iron hovering over the damp stone floor, rising steam and heat waves warping the air, before cutting to Catherine's gloating expression.
Faint sizzling and hissing as ambient moisture touches the scalding iron tip.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "And everyone watched you walk away alone."

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "Gerald chose money."

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "Clarissa chose a coward."

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "I chose myself."

boundary_events.text: Full shot framed through the arched doorway. Catherine stands imperiously in an ornate, gold-embroidered violet gown, holding a smoldering hot poker and a charred leather-bound book, flanked by two stone-faced guards with lanterns.
Close-up pushing in on Juliana's illuminated, dignified face.

events.speaker: MAID
events.text: "Yes, my Lord."

events.speaker: LORD
events.text: "And who saved him?"

events.text: "Lady Juliana."

events.speaker: LORD
events.text: "Tell me how."

Close-up on Alexander's hardened, shadowed profile, his jaw tight with grim memories.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "Most of them were."

events.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
events.text: "Then how did you survive?"
Side profile of Alexander as his eyes look into the distance, haunted by the past.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "I wasn't supposed to."
Alexander steps over to the wooden table, looking down at the parchment map spread out under the lantern.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "Three years ago, I was sent to the Iberian front."
Close-up of Alexander's weathered face looking down pensively as he recounts the mission.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "It was a classified Crown mission. We were investigating a British officer selling military secrets to French spies."
Alexander's scarred finger points to a red-circled location on the parchment map marked near Madrid.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
events.text: "A traitor?"
Close-up on his mother, gasping with wide, horrified eyes.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "Yes."
Medium shot framing both of them across the wooden table bathed in amber lantern glow.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "We were close to finding him."

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "Then came the ambush."
Close-up on Alexander's scarred hand clenching into a fist, furiously crumbling the parchment map beneath his knuckles.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "My men were slaughtered."
Close-up of his mother clutching at her throat, tears glistening in her eyes.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
events.text: "And you?"

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "I was shot. Left for dead."

events.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
events.text: "Then why did they never find you?"
Close-up on Alexander, his dark combat scar prominent as his eyes burn with steady, cold intensity.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "Because they made certain no one would look."
Medium close-up on Alexander's mother, her hood framing her pale, weathered face as shock deepens across her features.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
events.text: "Who?"
Side profile shot of Alexander gazing toward the open doorway before slowly turning back to face his mother directly.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "Sterling... and Rupert."
Tight close-up on Alexander's mother as her breath hitches and her eyes widen in pure horror.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
events.text: "Rupert?"
Wide shot of the wooden cabin interior. Alexander stands upright opposite his mother across the lantern-lit map.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "They knew where I was."
Close-up on Alexander leaning over the table, his eyes locked onto his mother as suppressed rage surfaces.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "My position was leaked to the French... before I could expose what I had discovered."
Close-up of Alexander's mother clutching the collar of her dark cloak, her chest heaving with agony.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
events.text: "They gave you to the enemy?"
Medium close-up of Alexander straightening his posture, his jaw set hard.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "They gave them my location."
Extreme close-up on Alexander's eyes and scarred cheek, teeth bared in contempt.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "They wanted the investigation buried."
Medium close-up of Alexander's mother leaning over the map, her voice cracking.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
events.text: "And when you disappeared...?"
Close-up on Alexander, his voice low and cutting.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "They declared me dead."
Medium shot from the side of the wooden table as his mother brings both hands up to cover her mouth in overwhelmed grief.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "They falsified what remained of the reports."
Alexander's mother presses her trembling hands against her lips, tears brimming in her eyes.
Tight close-up on his mother weeping openly, her ring catching the warm lamplight as she lowers her hand to her heart.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
events.text: "And Rupert took Ashbourne."
Tight close-up on Alexander's piercing blue-grey eyes, unwavering and hardened by years of exile.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "While the world mourned a dead heir."
Close-up on his mother's sorrowful gaze lifting toward him.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
events.text: "And I mourned you."

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "I know."

candidates.scene_heading: INT. ASHBRIDGE MANOR - GRAND CORRIDOR – DAY

events.text: The crisp tap of heavy cardstock envelopes being set down onto silver.
Medium two-shot framed symmetrically down the vaulted, sunlit hallway. Blond Nobleman Rupert stands tall in a black embroidered frock coat, facing Catherine in an ornate pink gown.

events.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
events.text: "Every important family in the county should witness it."
Close-up of Catherine looking down at the invitations, her braided blonde hair immaculately pinned, before she raises her eyes with a slight smirk.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "The wedding?"
Close-up on Rupert, his sharp aristocratic features set in cold conviction.

events.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
events.text: "The transfer of Ashbridge."
Medium close-up of Catherine picking up one of the invitations, turning it over in her gloved hands with predatory delight.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "After the ceremony, no one will question who owns this house."
Intense close-up of Rupert leaning in slightly, his eyes narrowing with venomous malice.

events.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
events.text: "And no one will question what happened to the woman who tried to stop us."
Tight close-up of Catherine as a cruel sneer twists her lips.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "Juliana's execution comes after the wedding."
Wide shot framing the two conspirators beneath the towering archways of the estate.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "Perfect timing. It will be a feast for our guests."
Medium close-up of Rupert turning his gaze toward the grand entrance.

events.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
events.text: "Send the invitations."
Close-up of Catherine looking sideways with narrowed eyes.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "Especially to the Ashcrofts."

events.text: Echoing, heavy bootsteps approach down the corridor outside the cell.
Tight close-up on Juliana's profile as her head turns toward the corridor, her blue eyes widening with cautious alarm.
Juliana blinks, lifting her gaze toward the heavy iron bars.
Medium shot through the cell bars as a Guard in a black collared uniform with silver buttons halts outside.
The Guard pauses, glancing over his shoulder into the gloomy corridor to ensure he is unobserved.
Low-angle shot focusing on the wet flagstones at the base of the cell door.
The Guard kneels down and slips a small loaf of rustic bread through the bottom gap between the iron bars, nudging it inside before withdrawing his gloved hand.
Low-angle close-up of Juliana crawling forward across the stone floor toward the bread, her gaze fixed on the offering in disbelief.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "Why?"

events.speaker: GUARD
events.text: "Because no one should die hungry."
Medium close-up of the Guard looking through the vertical bars with quiet compassion.

events.speaker: GUARD
events.text: "Eat it before they see."
Over-the-shoulder shot through the cell bars as the Guard turns and walks swiftly away into the dark corridor.
The Guard's silhouette retreats into the shadows.

boundary_events.text: Juliana sits motionless against the cold masonry, weak and visibly drained from starvation, her eyes cast downward.
Medium profile shot of Juliana slumped on the damp stone floor of her dark dungeon cell, her wrists bound in heavy iron shackles and chains draped over her lap.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "Alexander..."

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.text: "...are you safe?"

events.text: Wide crane shot panning down as a horse-drawn cart loaded with cut firewood pulls up along the wet stone pavement in front of the cathedral steps.
A lone driver in rugged attire guides the horse cart slowly toward the sentries guarding the arched entryway.
Medium two-shot of the royal sentry stepping forward and extending a white-gloved hand to halt the cart.

events.speaker: ROYAL SENTRY
events.text: "Stop!"

events.speaker: CART DRIVER
events.text: "Firewood for the kitchens, sir."
Fast dynamic medium shot as the cart driver suddenly lunges off the wooden bench.
The driver leaps off the cart, striking the sentry across the chest, seizing his neck, and tackling him violently against the wooden carriage wheel.
Dull physical thuds and scuffling boots on wet stone as the guard groans in surprise.
Medium close-up as a second loyalist emerges from behind the doorway, wrapping his arms around the remaining royal guard's throat from behind.
The loyalist locks the sentry into a tight sleeper hold, clamping a hand firmly over his mouth until his eyes roll back and he goes limp.

events.speaker: LOYALIST FIGHTER
events.text: "Sleep."
Wide high-angle shot overlooking the stone cathedral steps where both royal guards lie unconscious on the fallen autumn leaves while more men slip inside the opened doors.

events.speaker: CART DRIVER
events.text: "The road is clear."

events.speaker: LOYALIST FIGHTER
events.text: "Tell the Duke."

boundary_events.text: Medium low-angle shot of the two loyalist fighters looking up into the overcast sky outside the stone sanctuary.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "Wait."

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "Before I become Duchess of Ashburgh..."

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "...I want everyone to see what happens to a woman who dares defy this family."
Close-up of Catherine's face, her lips curling into a sadistic, triumphant sneer.

events.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
events.text: "Catherine..."

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "Bring her in."

Juliana, dressed in a coarse drab prison dress with a numbered identification badge, is marched forward by two armed constables holding her by the arms.
Extreme close-up of Juliana's scarred, dirtied wrists bound tight in heavy iron shackles.
Intense close-up of Juliana's bruised, dirt-streaked face. Her piercing blue eyes burn with fierce dignity despite her captive state.
Medium shot of Catherine standing beside the altar, watching Juliana's entrance with gloating satisfaction.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "There she is."
Medium tracking shot of Juliana marching between the stern constables down the central aisle toward the altar.
Medium shot of a seated aristocratic couple in the pews, whispering and sneering behind an ivory lace fan.

events.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
events.text: "Look at her."

events.speaker: NOBLEMAN
events.text: "She actually came back to the chapel."
Close-up of the noblewoman giggling with hand over mouth, glancing spitefully at the disgraced bride.

events.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
events.text: "Not as a bride this time."

events.text: Wide shot of the ruined nave littered with rubble as royal redcoat guards surround the aisle, forcing Rupert down onto his knees.
A royal redcoat guard firmly forces Rupert down into the stone dust.

events.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
events.text: "Get your hands off me! Catherine!"
Close-up on Rupert struggling fiercely against the white-gloved grip of the guard pinning his shoulder.

events.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
events.text: "Do something!"
Medium close-up on Catherine beneath her bridal veil, looking downward in conflicted silence.
Catherine's satin-gloved hand clenches tightly into a trembling fist against the folds of her ornate gown.
Close-up on Catherine's gloved hand tightening into a fist.
Wide shot as Catherine gathers her heavy train and steps away from Rupert, walking toward Alexander who stands watching her stoically.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "Alexander... I thought you had died."
Close-up on Catherine's face, tears glistening in her eyes as grief breaks through her composure.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "Do you know what this did to me?"
Medium shot on Alexander standing tall in his ducal coat, his gaze utterly detached.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "I mourned you."
Profile close-up of Catherine as a tear slips down her cheek.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "I waited for you."
Medium shot of Catherine standing in the center of the aisle before the seated congregation.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "For three years, I believed the man I loved was buried somewhere across the sea."
Tracking two-shot over Alexander's shoulder as Catherine approaches him pleadingly.
Close profile two-shot as Catherine gently reaches her gloved hand up to Alexander's bearded cheek.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "I never stopped loving you."
Alexander abruptly pulls his face back, refusing her touch and leaving her hand suspended in mid-air.
Close-up on Catherine's empty gloved hand trembling in the empty space between them.
Close-up on Catherine lowering her hand, stunned and deeply hurt by his rejection.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "You don't remember?"
High-angle shot looking down at Catherine in the foreground, with Rupert held under guard in the background.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "I was supposed to be your Duchess!"
Medium two-shot of Catherine and Alexander confronting each other.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "You were never my Duchess."
Extreme close-up on Catherine's tearful face.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "But I loved you!"

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "You loved the Duke you thought you would marry."
Medium close-up on Alexander, his scarred jaw set firm.
Close-up on Catherine, gasping in protest.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "No!"
Medium shot as Catherine clutches her chest, pouring her heart out.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "I loved you before all this!"

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.text: "Did you?"

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "Two words, and that healer's crown rolls right back into the gutter where it belongs."
Close-up on Catherine's profile and jewelry as she speaks with calculating contempt.
Catherine glides across the chamber past a roaring stone hearth, picking up an orange from a silver platter on the table.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "Ten days. He gave himself ten days to fix it."
Medium close-up frontal shot of Catherine turning directly toward the viewer, her expression tightening into ruthless determination.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "Ten days for the council to sit."
Catherine raises a gloved index finger, emphasizing each point with sinister precision.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "Ten days for witnesses to be gathered."

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "Ten days for a decree to be undone."

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "Ten days is not a wall, Alexander. It's a door."

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "And doors can be closed from the other side."

Slight push-in on Catherine as she clenches her fist against her chest, her eyes blazing with malice.

events.text: "You sent for me, my lady?"

events.text: "Lock it."

events.text: "Everyone in that chapel saw me humiliated today."

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "Good. Let them remember it."

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.text: "Grief makes people careless, and carelessness is exactly what I need from that household right now."
